In 2016 when terrorists infiltrated the Air Force Station at Pathankot, India's Special Forces swung into action to eliminate the threat and secure the base. This is the true story of their courage and valour to isolate and neutralise the terrorists. Watch the first hand account of the action as it unfolded through those behind the mission in tonight at 7 PM only on HistoryTV18.
This is a multi-audio video. You can choose Hindi or English audio by clicking (Settings) under video and selecting the Audio Track.​
